prs.current_body:
Closed because L-meta-3600 now has three accepted live reductions, the maximum allowed by the participation instructions. The repaired reduction and its complete local checker log are preserved in the research archive: https://github.com/KasuganoLove/pequalnp-proofs/tree/e2fbf8407858adb89826b2fb7dca90576b0e1866/research/2026-11-25/continuation-4/L-meta-3600

The repair replaces the gateAt unfolding with List.getD_eq_getElem, avoiding the extra declaration gateAt.eq_1 identified by the official rejection. The pinned project checker now reports ACCEPTED (reduce), exit 0, with 1,667 constants rechecked. This is a local result; the original official verdict remains REJECTED and no new official acceptance is claimed.

The two hypotheses and exact original conclusion are unchanged: the ReadK.lineSingle incidence class is bounded by 6 * C.size, and its complement by 94 * C.size. The first child has a complete proof; the complementary child is still open. This reduction does not prove the entire circuit lower bound.

The first-child proof adapts the counting argument of upstream L_meta_2462, weakening full correctness to canonical one-line rejection and exposing the existing argument's stronger constant 6. Its exact adaptation to the separately posted L-meta-7019 also passed the pinned local checker (1,834 constants), and is preserved in the same archive pending normal desk allocation.

No custom data type or instance is declared. The repaired branch retains one commit adding one Lean file.
